value.rationale: For the canonical frustrated ANNNI chain, complete classification of exactly the new minima excluded by the smallest simultaneous cooperative update is a natural kinetic-landscape invariant. Its phase-dependent allowed domain scales yield two distinct off-critical exponential entropy losses, while multiphase-point minima resist pair moves; this contrasts frustration-driven and ferromagnetic local blocking without depending on arbitrary finite slices.
